claims.statement: Economics_app is not primitive. It is a dominant-domain projected governance domain arising from preserved, recoverable, and productively coupled organizations of admissible distinction.
claims.compressed_form: Economics_app := Projection(ΣD populations under admissible exchange, recovery, and coupling dynamics)

claims.statement: Economic observables are dominant-domain projections of cumulative Effects produced by relational Affects between whole-expression A|E forms as they propagate through admissible progression.
claims.boundary_clause: Traceability to (*|*) -> (A|E) -> <*>_x -> <->_x is required, but traceability does not imply semantic equivalence to non-economic domains.

laws.name: Organization Before Wealth
laws.statement: Mismatch inventory becomes economic wealth only after admissible organization.

laws.name: Distinction Loss Constraint
laws.statement: A system cannot increase long-term realized distinction wealth if structurally significant distinction loss persistently exceeds recovery or regeneration.

laws.name: Fragmentation Limit
laws.statement: Increasing raw distinction inventory can reduce wealth if it destroys admissibility, coupling, or recovery capacity.

laws.name: Coupling Productivity Principle
laws.statement: Economic growth increases when non-equivalent Sigma_D structures productively couple without collapsing into uniformity.

laws.name: Resilience Through Redundant Distinction
laws.statement: Systems with multiple admissible Sigma_D pathways recover better than systems dependent on concentrated single-path organization.
